title: 第558章 死斗第557章 钱快来身死
content_zh:
观火人说完话金龙殿内陷入了死寂，观火人头贴在地上不敢抬头，钱金龙沉默了良久，最终将手中的酒杯摔在地上喝道：“去给我查！到底是谁杀了快来！我要让那家伙偿命！”
“是！我现在就去查！”观火人立刻回话，然后倒退着走出金龙殿。
乾元剑宗秘境内，杨修三人已经顺利回到了乾元客栈，吴天昊并没有跟着几人来乾元客栈，而是返回乾元剑宗调查两女被绑架的原因。
“早些休息吧！明天你还有比试，据我推测让钱快来绑架你的大概率就是你明天的强力对手！”杨修看着在涂抹伤药的罗素云说道。
罗素云手上动作一顿，随后笑了笑说道：“小师叔！我决定明天火力全开，如果出了什么事情还请您为我兜底！”
杨修淡淡点了点头，罗素云得到想要的答案，内心松了一口气，不止如此一股压抑许久的火气爬上了她的心头。
“清幽你弄好了吗？我们回去吧！不要打扰小师叔休息了！”罗素云转头看向夏清幽，却发现夏清幽已经困的开始点头了，她笑了笑将夏清幽摇醒便离开了杨修的房间。
第二天早晨杨修三人早早便来到了剑斗场，让杨修没想到的是吴天昊居然早早就出现在这里，在他身边还站着一个男子，这人杨修很是熟悉，正是之前对夏清幽下杀手的楚沧澜，杨修转头看向身后的夏清幽想看看她的反应。
夏清幽表情很是平淡，就好像楚沧澜于她而言是个陌生人一般。
吴天昊看到杨修三人到来立刻围了上去说道：“杨兄弟你来了呀！我昨天晚上已经调查清楚了，就是这小子联合钱快来对罗师侄动手的，你看……”
杨修没有回答而是转头看向罗素云，他的态度很明显，一切由罗素云做主，罗素云感受到杨修的目光，立刻摆摆手说道：“我的要求很简单，吴宗主吴要求跟他生死斗！”
吴天昊闻言有些吃惊，但最终目光还是落在杨修身上，杨修点点头说道：“按照她说的办吧！”
吴天昊点点头对着不远处招招手，不一会儿便有一个宗门长老走了过来，吴天昊在他耳边低语几句，宗门长老快步离去，杨修几人等了不到两分钟，这位宗门长老再次出现，在他手里还拿着两张纸，杨修粗略扫过，上面的大致内容是两人战斗由一方死亡结束！
罗素云接过纸没有犹豫立刻写上自己的名字还按了手印，等到两张纸摆到楚沧澜面前，他脸上露出迟疑，但当他对上吴天昊的眼睛时，一股强烈的恐惧感充满了内心，他立刻别过头将目光转向罗素云咬牙切齿的低吼道：“你就这么肯定能赢得了我？你不觉得自己有些狂妄吗？从已经进行过的战斗来看，你我之间大概率是五五开，所以我认为没必要……”
罗素云摆摆手打断楚沧澜：“你怎么磨磨唧唧跟个娘们似的，你要知道我这是给你一个机会，如果你签了这条约是有概率能顺利进入剑林的，但如果你不签那你一定进不去，你确定要放弃这次进入剑林的机会嘛？”
罗素云说到这里楚沧澜也不再迟疑，立刻写下自己名字咬破手指按了手印，罗素云见楚沧澜已经签下也不停留，跟着杨修便离开了，楚沧澜也在吴天昊的允许下离开了。
“咳咳咳～”拿着契约的长老要离开，却被吴天昊连续不断的咳嗽声打断了。
“宗主您还有什么事情吗？”拿着契约的长老有些不解的问道。
吴天昊伸手揽住他的肩膀，压低声音说道：“我跟你说一个事情，这两人的比赛楚沧澜可以死，但罗素云不能死你懂吗？”
拿着契约的长老先是一愣，随后立刻点头说道：“如果到时候庆阳书院弟子真的有危险，我会撕毁条约出手救人的！”

吴天昊满意点点头，最后在拿着契约的长老肩头拍了拍便离开了，拿着契约的长老低头再次看了一眼手中的契约，笑了笑也离开了。
“哇哇哇～那是庆阳书院的那名女弟子吧！怎么这么厉害了！我记得她之前可是没有这么强的啊！”
“啧啧啧～你懂什么这一看就是之前隐藏了真实实力啊！你看看她的招式多么干净利落！如果不是我加入了乾元剑宗，我一定会找她拜师的！”
“你最好是拜师，不是看上人家的姿色！”
“哈哈哈～此等姿色谁不喜欢？”
看台上传来热闹的欢呼声，他们都在惊讶今天罗素云的强大，反观在角落里等待着下一场比试的楚沧澜则是面如死灰，因为他能明确感受到罗素云的实力，高出了他不止一筹。
“既然这么厉害为什么要隐藏自己？是不是针对我？”楚沧澜双眼通红的蹲在地上，以往围着他的小弟们都离他远远的，因为他们已经被吴天昊警告过了。
“下一场！罗素云对战楚沧澜！这是一场特别的战斗，让我们看看是庆阳书院的女弟子会取胜，还是我们乾元剑宗的楚沧澜会胜！让我们欢迎他们入场！”随着场内长老的声音响起，四周观看比试的乾元剑宗瞬间沸腾起来。
“罗素云！”
“罗素云！”
“罗素云！”
随着长老退出剑斗场，一阵阵叫喊声响起，这些人都是支持罗素云的，而支持楚沧澜的并非没有，他们坐落在观众的各处用最小的声音喊着楚沧澜的名字，仿佛说出这个名字是莫大的耻辱。
罗素云深呼吸一口气缓缓走到剑斗场中央，而在她对面的楚沧澜步伐更是缓慢，罗素云死死盯着楚沧澜的脸，想从他的脸上看出恐惧，但让他意外的是楚沧澜面色很平静，这让他很是意外。
“你真的觉得一定能赢过我嘛？”楚沧澜抬起头目光与罗素云对视。
“疯子！”罗素云看到楚沧澜的眼睛两个字从她心里不由自主的升起，下一秒楚沧澜的双眼肉眼可见的变红，这让罗素云内心充满了不安。
content_en:
After the fire watcher finished speaking, the Golden Dragon Hall fell into dead silence. The fire watcher put his head on the ground and did not dare to raise his head. Qian Jinlong was silent for a long time, and finally threw the wine glass in his hand to the ground and shouted: "Go and find out! Who killed him? Come on! I want that guy to pay for his life!"
"Yes! I'm going to check now!" The fire watcher replied immediately, and then walked backwards out of the Golden Dragon Palace.
In the secret territory of the Qianyuan Sword Sect, Yang Xiu and the others had successfully returned to the Qianyuan Inn. Wu Tianhao did not follow the others to the Qianyuan Inn, but returned to the Qianyuan Sword Sect to investigate the reason why the two women were kidnapped.
"Go to rest early! You have a competition tomorrow. According to my guess, there is a high probability that Qian will kidnap you and you will be your strong opponent tomorrow!" Yang Xiu said while looking at Russell Yun who was applying the medicine on his wounds.
Russell Yun moved his hands for a moment, then smiled and said: "Uncle Junior! I have decided to go all out tomorrow. If anything happens, please take care of me!"
Yang Xiu nodded lightly. Russell Yun breathed a sigh of relief when she got the answer she wanted. Not only that, but a long-suppressed anger climbed into her heart.
"Karen, are you done? Let's go back! Don't disturb the little uncle's rest!" Russell Yun turned to look at Karen Xia, only to find that Karen Xia was already nodding sleepily. She smiled, shook Karen Xia awake and left Yang Xiu's room.
The next morning, the three of Yang Xiu arrived at the sword fighting arena early. What Yang Xiu didn't expect was that Wu Tianhao would actually appear here early. There was a man standing next to him. This man Yang Xiu was very familiar with. It was Chu Canglan who had killed Karen Xia before. Yang Xiu turned to look at Karen Xia behind him to see her reaction.
Karen Xia's expression was very calm, as if Chu Canglan was a stranger to her.
When Wu Tianhao saw the arrival of Yang Xiu and the others, he immediately surrounded them and said, "Brother Yang, you are here! I have investigated clearly last night. It was this guy who came together with the money to attack Junior Nephew Luo. Look..."
Yang Xiu did not answer but turned to look at Russell Yun. His attitude was very clear. Russell Yun made the decision in everything. Feeling Yang Xiu's gaze, Russell Yun immediately waved his hand and said, "My request is very simple. Sect Master Wu wants to fight him to the death!"
Wu Tianhao was a little surprised when he heard this, but in the end his eyes fell on Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu nodded and said, "Do as she said!"
Wu Tianhao nodded and waved to someone not far away. After a while, a sect elder came over. Wu Tianhao whispered a few words in his ear. The sect elder left quickly. Yang Xiu and others waited for less than two minutes. The sect elder appeared again, holding two pieces of paper in his hand. Yang Xiu scanned it roughly. The general content on it was that the battle between the two ended with the death of one of the parties!
Russell Yun took the paper without hesitation and immediately wrote his name and fingerprinted it. When the two pieces of paper were placed in front of Chu Canglan, he hesitated on his face, but when he met Wu Tianhao's eyes, a strong sense of fear filled his heart, and he immediately looked away. Turning his head to Russell Yun, he gritted his teeth and growled: "Are you so sure that you can win me? Don't you think you are a little arrogant? Judging from the battles that have been fought, the probability between you and me is 50-50, so I don't think it is necessary..."
Russell Yun waved his hand and interrupted Chu Canglan: "Why are you acting like a girl? You have to know that I am giving you a chance. If you sign this treaty, there is a chance that you can enter the Sword Forest smoothly, but if you don't sign, you will definitely not be able to enter. Are you sure you want to give up this opportunity to enter the Sword Forest?"
When Russell Yun said this, Chu Canglan no longer hesitated. He immediately wrote his name, bit off his fingers and pressed his fingerprints. Seeing that Chu Canglan had signed, Russell Yun did not stop and left with Yang Xiu. Chu Canglan also left with Wu Tianhao's permission.
"Cough cough cough~" The elder holding the contract was about to leave, but was interrupted by Wu Tianhao's continuous coughing.
"Sect Master, are you stillWhat's going on? "The elder holding the contract asked with some confusion.
Wu Tianhao put his arm around his shoulders and lowered his voice and said: "Let me tell you something, Chu Canglan can die in the match between these two people, but Russell Yun cannot die, do you understand? "
The elder holding the contract was stunned for a moment, then immediately nodded and said: "If the disciples of Qingyang Academy are really in danger by then, I will tear up the contract and rescue them! "
Wu Tianhao nodded with satisfaction, finally patted the elder holding the contract on the shoulder and left. The elder holding the contract lowered his head and looked at the contract in his hand again, smiled and left.
"Wow wow wow ~ That's the female disciple from Qingyang Academy! Why is it so awesome! I remember she wasn't this strong before! "
"Tsk, tsk, tsk~ What do you know? It seems like you were hiding your true strength before! Look how neat her moves are! If I hadn't joined the Qianyuan Sword Sect, I would have definitely sought her apprenticeship! "
"It's better for you to become a disciple, rather than just looking at someone else's beauty! "
"Hahaha~ Who doesn't like such beauty? "
Lively cheers came from the stands. They were all surprised at how powerful Russell Yun was today. On the other hand, Chu Canglan, who was waiting for the next competition in the corner, had a pale face because he could clearly feel that Russell Yun's strength was more than one step ahead of him.
"If you are so powerful, why hide yourself? Is it directed at me? "Chu Canglan squatted on the ground with red eyes. The younger brothers who used to surround him stayed away from him because they had been warned by Wu Tianhao.
"Next game! Russell Yun versus Chu Canglan! This is a special battle, let’s see whether the female disciples from Qingyang Academy will win, or Chu Canglan from our Qianyuan Sword Sect! Let us welcome them on board! "As the voice of the elders in the field rang out, the Qianyuan Sword Sect watching the competition instantly became excited.
“Russell Cloud! "
“Russell Cloud! "
“Russell Cloud! "
As the elders exited the sword fighting arena, bursts of shouts rang out. These people all supported Russell Yun, and it was not without those who supported Chu Canglan. They were located in various places in the audience and shouted Chu Canglan's name in the smallest voice, as if it was a great shame to say this name.
Russell Yun took a deep breath and walked slowly to the center of the sword fighting arena, while Chu Canglan opposite her walked even more slowly. Russell Yun stared at Chu Canglan's face, trying to see the fear on his face, but what surprised him was that Chu Canglan's face was very calm, which surprised him.
"Do you really think you can beat me? "Chu Canglan raised his head and looked at Russell Yun.
"Madman! "Russell Yun saw the word Chu Canglan's eyes rising involuntarily from her heart. The next second, Chu Canglan's eyes turned red visibly, which made Russell Yun full of uneasiness.
